nodes.description: Public owner address of the Ownable base contract; set in the constructor from msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Boolean flag set by _init; guards registerDepositor, deposit, withdraw and slash through the isInitialised modifier.
Boolean flag set when deposit() succeeds; guards deposit (isNotDeposited) and withdraw/slash (isDeposited).
Address authorised to call slash(); compared against msg.sender.
Address (auction contract) allowed to call registerDepositor and deposit; compared against msg.sender.
Timestamp after which withdrawals are allowed; compared against block.timestamp in withdraw and in _init.
Mapping(address=>bool) tracking depositors that may still withdraw; registered, cleared on withdraw/slash.
Counter of successfully registered depositors, incremented in registerDepositor and used in deposit.
Amount paid per depositor, set in deposit and used by withdraw and slash.
ERC20 token contract whose deposits are locked; set in TokenDepositLocker.init.
Sets owner = msg.sender on deployment.
onlyOwner function that replaces owner with newOwner if it is not the zero address.
Registers a depositor: onlyDepositorsProxy + isInitialised + isNotDeposited, flips canWithdraw entry and increments numberOfDepositors.
Payable function calculating depositAmount = numberOfDepositors * _valuePerDepositor, storing value, flagging deposited and calling the _receive hook.
Time-gated withdrawal: requires block.timestamp >= releaseTimestamp and canWithdraw[msg.sender], clears the flag then calls the _transfer hook to msg.sender.
Slasher-only function that clears canWithdraw[_depositorToBeSlashed] and burns valuePerDepositor through the _burn hook.
Internal initialiser that sets releaseTimestamp, slasher, depositorsProxy, initialized and clears owner.
Empty fallback() that silently accepts calls/ETH with no logic.
onlyOwner initialiser that delegates to BaseDepositLocker._init and stores the ERC20 token address.
Hook overriding _receive; requires msg.value == 0 and pulls tokens with token.transferFrom.
Hook overriding _transfer; pushes tokens to the recipient with token.transfer.
Hook overriding _burn; destroys tokens with token.burn.
Abstract virtual hook declared for derived contracts to receive deposits.
Abstract virtual hook declared for derived contracts to transfer deposits.
Abstract virtual hook declared for derived contracts to burn deposits.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, proxy/slasher authorisation, depositor indexing and value transfer recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against releaseTimestamp in withdraw and in _init.
External ERC20 call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) inside TokenDepositLocker._receive; return value is not checked.
External ERC20 call token.transfer(recipient, amount) inside TokenDepositLocker._transfer; return value is not checked.
External ERC20 call token.burn(amount) inside TokenDepositLocker._burn; burns from the lock contract itself.
Address registered as a depositor in registerDepositor.
Per-depositor amount supplied to deposit.
Address whose deposit is burned in slash.
Future timestamp stored as releaseTimestamp in _init.
Authorised slasher address stored in _init.
Depositors proxy address stored in _init.
Replacement owner passed to transferOwnership.
ERC20 token address passed to TokenDepositLocker.init.
Token amount pulled in _receive.
Token recipient passed to _transfer.
Token amount sent in _transfer.
Token amount burned in _burn.
Local computed as numberOfDepositors * _valuePerDepositor in deposit, checked against division.
Release timestamp forwarded from TokenDepositLocker.init to _init.
Slasher address forwarded from TokenDepositLocker.init to _init.
Depositors proxy address forwarded from TokenDepositLocker.init to _init.

edges.reason: Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership rewrites owner, gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
registerDepositor sets canWithdraw[_depositor] = true.
registerDepositor increments numberOfDepositors.
isInitialised modifier reads initialized before registering.
isNotDeposited modifier reads deposited before registering.
onlyDepositorsProxy modifier reads depositorsProxy for the caller check.
deposit reads numberOfDepositors to compute depositAmount.
deposit writes valuePerDepositor.
deposit sets deposited = true.
isInitialised modifier reads initialized in deposit.
onlyDepositorsProxy modifier reads depositorsProxy in deposit.
withdraw gates on block.timestamp >= releaseTimestamp, a timestamp dependency.
withdraw reads and clears canWithdraw[msg.sender].
withdraw reads valuePerDepositor for the payout.
isInitialised modifier reads initialized in withdraw.
isDeposited modifier reads deposited in withdraw.
slash requires msg.sender == slasher.
slash clears canWithdraw[_depositorToBeSlashed].
slash reads valuePerDepositor for the burn amount.
isInitialised modifier reads initialized in slash.
isDeposited modifier reads deposited in slash.
_init sets initialized = true.
_init writes slasher.
_init writes depositorsProxy.
_init writes releaseTimestamp.
_init sets owner = address(0), permanently disabling the onlyOwner path after initialisation.
TokenDepositLocker.init writes the token address.
TokenDepositLocker.init is guarded by onlyOwner, which reads owner.
owner is initialised from msg.sender in the constructor.
msg.sender must equal owner through onlyOwner for transferOwnership.
msg.sender must equal depositorsProxy in registerDepositor.
msg.sender must equal depositorsProxy in deposit.
msg.sender indexes canWithdraw and is the value-transfer recipient in withdraw, the classic reentrancy entry point.
msg.sender must equal slasher in slash.
msg.sender is passed as the from address of token.transferFrom in _receive.
msg.sender flows directly into the external token.transferFrom call as source.
withdraw releases funds based on the miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
_init requires _releaseTimestamp > block.timestamp, another timestamp dependency.
deposit invokes the abstract _receive hook after state updates.
withdraw invokes the abstract _transfer hook after clearing canWithdraw.
slash invokes the abstract _burn hook after clearing canWithdraw.
TokenDepositLocker.init internally calls BaseDepositLocker._init.
Virtual _receive is resolved to the TokenDepositLocker._receive override.
Virtual _transfer is resolved to the TokenDepositLocker._transfer override.
Virtual _burn is resolved to the TokenDepositLocker._burn override.
External token.transferFrom inside _receive can re-enter deposit; deposited is set before the call, which mitigates the hazard.
External token.transfer inside _transfer can re-enter withdraw; canWithdraw[msg.sender] is cleared before the call (CEI respected).
External token.burn inside _burn can re-enter slash; the canWithdraw flag is cleared before the call.
_receive performs the unchecked external token.transferFrom call.
_transfer performs the unchecked external token.transfer call.
_burn performs the unchecked external token.burn call.
_depositor is the registered address argument of registerDepositor.
_depositor is used as the canWithdraw mapping key.
_valuePerDepositor is the amount argument of deposit.
_valuePerDepositor is stored into valuePerDepositor.
_valuePerDepositor is a multiplication operand of depositAmount.
depositAmount = numberOfDepositors * _valuePerDepositor; the code checks overflow by re-dividing.
_depositorToBeSlashed is the slash argument.
_depositorToBeSlashed indexes canWithdraw in slash.
_releaseTimestamp parameter of _init.
_releaseTimestamp is stored into releaseTimestamp.
_slasher parameter of _init.
_slasher is stored into the slasher state variable.
_depositorsProxy parameter of _init.
_depositorsProxy is stored into depositorsProxy.
newOwner is the onlyOwner-gated argument of transferOwnership that rewrites owner.
_token is the ERC20 argument of TokenDepositLocker.init.
_token is stored into the token state variable.
TokenDepositLocker.init._releaseTimestamp forwarded to _init.
TokenDepositLocker.init._slasher forwarded to _init.
TokenDepositLocker.init._depositorsProxy forwarded to _init.
amount is the pulled-token amount in _receive.
amount is passed directly into token.transferFrom.
recipient is the destination of _transfer.
recipient is passed directly into token.transfer.
amount is the sent-token amount in _transfer.
amount is passed directly into token.transfer.
amount is the burned-token amount in _burn.
amount is passed directly into token.burn.
